Name: steam_profile_button
Description: Opens a player's Steam profile from the ESC squad menu. Press ESC, then F7, and a [Profile] button appears next to each squad member. Click to open that player's Steam profile in the Steam overlay browser. Press F6 at any time to rescan the current session. Read-only. Hotkey: F7 (while ESC menu is open), F6 (any time).
